info.description:
Bo suu tap test tay module Bill va OCR.

Chay lan luot tu tren xuong. Moi request tu luu bien vao environment, nen ban khong can copy paste ID thu cong va khong can cham database.

Tao truoc mot environment co bien base_url = http://localhost:8080

item.name: 1. Tao hoa don va xem chia tien
1.1 Tao hoa don thu cong, tong LE 100001

request.description:
Dung tong LE (100001) co y, de thay phan du 1 dong di ve dau.

100001 chia doi ra 50000 moi nguoi, du 1 dong. Dong do phai ve Creditor (nguoi tao hoa don, o day la nguoi A).

Day la request quan trong nhat.

Nhin vao breakdown:
- Creditor: final_amount 50001, rounding_adjustment 1
- Nguoi con lai: final_amount 50000, rounding_adjustment 0
- Tong 100001, khop tuyet doi voi bill.total

Tab Test Results se tu kiem tra ba dieu do.

item.name: 1.3 Hoa don co mon chua gan ai, phai co ma chan
1.4 Doc hoa don do, xem ma chan

request.description:
Truoc khi sua, request nay tra 200 voi mismatch_codes rong va khong co breakdown, nen client khong phan biet duoc hoa don hong voi hoa don trong.

Bay gio no phai tra ITEM_UNASSIGNED.

item.name: 1.5 Hoa don giam gia lon hon tien hang

request.description: Phai tra ve hai ma: DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_BILL va TOTAL_MISMATCH.
Version phai la version HIEN TAI cua hoa don. Sai version tra 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

Chot so doi Creditor co tai khoan ngan hang. Neu nhan 422 BANK_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED thi chay request 1.8b truoc.

Sau khi chot so, bill_shares giu dung con so o buoc 1.2, va debts chi co MOT dong 50000 cho nguoi khong phai Creditor.

item.name: 1.8b Gan tai khoan ngan hang cho Creditor

request.description:
Chay cai nay neu 1.8 tra 422 BANK_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED, roi chay lai 1.8.

CAI BAY: bank_code phai la MA NGAN nhu ICB, VCB, BIDV. KHONG phai so BIN 970415.
Dua so BIN vao se nhan 400 UNSUPPORTED_BANK, va thong bao loi khong noi ro la ban dua sai dinh dang.

Chay GET /api/v1/banks de xem danh sach: moi ngan hang co ca 'code' (ICB) lan 'bin' (970415). Dung 'code'.

Ba truong phai gui cung luc, database co rang buoc bat cả ba cung null hoac cung co gia tri.

QUAN TRONG: sang tab Body > form-data, o dong 'images' bam Select Files va chon anh hoa don cua ban. Postman khong cho collection mang san duong dan file.

Dinh dang: JPEG, PNG hoac HEIC, toi da 10 MB, toi da 5 anh (them dong images nua neu muon nhieu anh).

DUNG dat Content-Type thu cong. Postman tu sinh boundary, dat tay se lam hong request.

Tra ve 202 (khong phai 201) kem ocr_job o trang thai queued.

DIEU BAN CAN BIET TRUOC: chi tiet hoa don KHONG tra ve trang thai job OCR.
Response chi co bill, breakdown, signed_urls. Trong bill khong co truong ocr_job nao.
Toi da kiem chung dieu nay tren server that.

Vay lam sao biet OCR xong chua trong Postman? Ba cach, chon mot:

CACH 1, de nhat: doi khoang 30 giay roi chay thang request 2.5 (apply-candidate).
  - Neu tra 409 OCR_NOT_READY thi job chua xong, doi them roi thu lai.
  - Neu tra 200 thi xong roi.

CACH 2: mo mot terminal ben canh va chay lenh SSE (xem mo ta request 2.2b).
  Day la duong duy nhat lo ra trang thai job, va la duong app di dong that su dung.

CACH 3: hoi thang database.
  docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d paysplit -c \
    "SELECT status, attempts FROM ocr_jobs WHERE bill_id='<bill id>';"

Request nay van huu ich: no kiem tra ban nhap CHUA bi OCR ghi de, va raw_response khong lot ra API.

exec: pm.test('Ban nhap chua bi OCR ghi de', () => {
pm.test('Co anh va URL da ky', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(d.signed_urls || {})).to.not.be.empty);
if (d.signed_urls) { const u = Object.values(d.signed_urls)[0]; pm.environment.set('signed_url', u); console.log('URL anh da ky:', u); }
console.log('Luu y: response nay KHONG chua trang thai job OCR. Xem mo ta request.');

item.name: 2.2b Xem SSE (doc mo ta, khong bam Send)

request.description:
Postman xu ly Server-Sent Events rat kem. Ban co the bam Send, nhung nhieu ban Postman se treo
cho toi khi het timeout roi moi do het mot cuc ra, thay vi hien tung su kien khi chung toi.

Cach chac chan hon la chay trong terminal:

  curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <tokenA>" \
    "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/bills/<ocr_bill_id>/events?group_id=<group_id>"

Lay tokenA, ocr_bill_id va group_id tu tab Environment cua Postman.

Ban se thay:
  event: snapshot      <- ngay khi ket noi, kem trang thai OCR hien tai
  event: ocr.updated   <- status chuyen processing roi succeeded
  event: heartbeat     <- moi 15 giay

Sau 15 phut server chu dong gui event: close va ngat, buoc client tu ket noi lai.
Ctrl+C de thoat.

item.name: 2.3 Kiem tra anh that su rieng tu

request.description:
Request nay tro thang toi Cloudinary, khong qua server cua ban.

Sua URL trong o dia chi thanh chinh gia tri bien signed_url (Postman khong noi bien tuyet doi tot o day, cach nhanh nhat la copy URL tu console cua request 2.2 va dan vao).

URL da ky phai tra 200.

Sau do sua URL: doi doan /image/private/s--XXXX--/v1/ thanh /image/upload/ roi goi lai. Phai tra 404. Neu no tra 200 thi anh hoa don cua nguoi dung dang lo ra internet, bao ngay.

item.name: 2.4 Ap dung ket qua OCR, version SAI

request.description:
Phai tra 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

Luu y co HAI loi version khac nhau:
- VERSION_CONFLICT: ban gui sai version hien tai
- OCR_RESULT_STALE: version dung nhung hoa don da bi sua ke tu luc job chay

item.name: 2.5 Ap dung ket qua OCR, version DUNG

request.description:
Bay gio ban nhap moi duoc ghi de bang du lieu OCR: merchant, ngay, danh sach mon, tong tien.
Version tang tu 1 len 2. Moi mon duoc gan deu cho tat ca thanh vien active theo mac dinh.

Neu tra 409 OCR_NOT_READY nghia la job chua chay xong. Doi them 10 giay roi bam Send lai.
Day cung la cach don gian nhat de biet OCR da xong chua, vi chi tiet hoa don khong lo trang thai job.

exec: console.log('Job chua xong (OCR_NOT_READY). Doi them roi bam Send lai.');

request.description:
Tra 202 kem mot job MOI. Job cu va candidate cu van con nguyen, khong bi ghi de.

Gioi han BILL_OCR_MANUAL_LIMIT lan (mac dinh 5) trong BILL_OCR_MANUAL_WINDOW_HOURS (mac dinh 24). Vuot qua tra 429 OCR_LIMIT_REACHED.

Doi job cu chua xong ma goi tiep se tra 409 OCR_ALREADY_RUNNING.

item.name: 2.7 Doc lai, kiem tra sua doi thu cong con nguyen

request.description:
Sau khi job thu hai xong, ban nhap phai giu nguyen nhung gi OCR lan mot da ghi vao
cong voi moi sua doi tay cua ban. Chay lai OCR khong bao gio tu ghi de.

Hai candidate deu con, nhung API khong lo chung ra. Muon xem ca hai thi hoi database:
  docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d paysplit -c \
    "SELECT id, status, (candidate->>'total') FROM ocr_jobs WHERE bill_id='<ocr_bill_id>' ORDER BY created_at;"

exec: pm.test('Van con mon, khong bi xoa boi lan OCR thu hai', () => pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty);

item.name: 2.8 Xem chia tien tren so lieu OCR

request.description:
Sau khi ap dung OCR, hoa don da co mon va phan cong. Xem breakdown de thay thuat toan chia san chay tren so lieu that.

Muon thay phan du di dau, dung request PUT /bills/{id} sua vat thanh 1 roi doc lai: khong ai trong so nguoi thuong nhan duoc 1 dong VAT do, nen Creditor lay.

exec: if (!bd.length) { console.log('Khong co breakdown, ma chan:', b.mismatch_codes); }
bd.forEach(a => console.log(a.member_id === b.creditor_member_id ? 'CREDITOR' : 'thanh vien', a.final_amount, 'adj', a.rounding_adjustment));
